title: Step 4 - NLP Data Cleaning: Lowercase Transformation in R for Text Analysis

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到教學。

cues.en: So now let's proceed to the next step of the cleaning process which is about removing all the numbers from the reviews.
cues.zh: 下一步清理，移除評論所有數字。

cues.en: So we will just copy this line and paste it below because you'll see that now doing the next steps of the cleaning process is going to be very easy because we will always use this same line here
cues.zh: 複製這行貼到下面，會看到之後很簡單，因為一直用同一行

cues.en: to update the corpus.
cues.zh: 更新 corpus。

cues.en: And at each new step we are going to apply the right transformation that we want to do for the particular step of the cleaning process to the whole corpus thanks to the TM map function.
cues.zh: 每一步，透過 tm_map，對整個語料庫套所需轉換。

cues.en: So basically what we just need to do is replace this content transformer with tool as input by remove numbers, and that's all.
cues.zh: 基本上只要把 content_transformer(tolower)，換成 removeNumbers。

cues.en: We apply this remove numbers function to the reviews in the corpus through the TM map function.
cues.zh: 透過 tm_map，對 corpus 評論套 removeNumbers。

cues.en: And that will remove all the numbers of all the 1000 reviews in the corpus.
cues.zh: 移除一千則所有數字。

cues.en: So let's check it out.
cues.zh: 檢查。

cues.en: To check that out we cannot do it with this first review because this first review doesn't contain any number so nothing will be removed here.
cues.zh: 第一則沒有數字，不會移除，所以不能用它看。

cues.en: But I had a look at the data set and there is the review 841 that contains a number.
cues.zh: 我看過資料，第 841 則有數字。

cues.en: Let's have a look at this review.
cues.zh: 看看這則。

cues.en: To do this, we will use the same line as we used to look at the first review.
cues.zh: 用和查看第一則相同的程式碼。

cues.en: So I'm pressing the up arrow here to take this line of code that gives us access to the reviews and inputting the index one here, we'll input the 841 index.
cues.zh: 按向上取得該行，把索引 1 換 841。

cues.en: And now let's press M to have a look at the review.
cues.zh: 按 Enter 看評論。

cues.en: And the review is for 40 bucks a head I really expect better food.
cues.zh: 「每人 40 元，我真的期待更好的食物。」

cues.en: So that's a negative review.
cues.zh: 負評。

cues.en: And what should be highlighted in this review is this 40 number here which we want to see if it's going to be removed.
cues.zh: 重點是 40，想知道會不會移除。

cues.en: Once we apply this, remove numbers function to the reviews of the corpus so that all the numbers in the reviews can be removed thanks to the TM map function.
cues.zh: 套 removeNumbers，透過 tm_map 去掉所有評論數字後。

cues.en: So let's check it out.
cues.zh: 檢查。

cues.en: We will select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選這行執行。

cues.en: Done. And now let's have a look at this 841 review.
cues.zh: 完成，再看第 841 則。

cues.en: So I'm pressing the up arrow twice to get back to this line of code, giving us the written review.
cues.zh: 向上兩次，取顯示文字的那行。

cues.en: So now the corpus is updated.
cues.zh: 語料庫更新了。

cues.en: Let's see if the number 40 disappeared and it did for bucks ahead, I really expect better food.
cues.zh: 40 消失了嗎？是的，現在只剩「每人元，我真的期待更好的食物」。

cues.en: 40 disappeared, and that's exactly what we wanted.
cues.zh: 40 不見，正是要的。

cues.en: So great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Basically all the numbers are now removed from the reviews in the corpus.
cues.zh: corpus 所有評論數字都移除了。

cues.en: Next step done, and we are ready to move on to the next step, which will be about removing any kind of punctuation in the reviews because of course in our sparse matrix, in the end
cues.zh: 這步完成，準備下一步，移除各種標點，因為最終稀疏矩陣，

cues.en: we don't want to get a column for a comma or another column for a colon or another column for a dot or for a semi colon or any kind of punctuation.
cues.zh: 不想有逗號欄、冒號欄、句點欄、分號或任何標點欄。

cues.en: Of course, we only want to create some columns for relevant words that will help the machine learning classification algorithm to see the correlations between the presence of the words and the outcome
cues.zh: 只想為有意義的詞建欄，幫助分類演算法理解詞存在

cues.en: whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 與正負結果的關聯。

cues.en: All right, so let's do that in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂做。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
